title: Three Travelers at Sunrise
description: Three people in robes walk away from the viewer across a hilly plain covered in dry grass and white flowers. The center figure holds a tall spear in his right hand while the left and right figures each carry a smaller spear.
prompt: Three robed figures seen from behind walk across a hilly plain covered in dry grass and white flowers. The center bearded man holds a tall spear upright in his right hand. The other two figures each carry a smaller spear. Bright sun rises on the horizon casting golden light across the scene with distant mountains under a blue sky with clouds.
